title: Light-induced modulation of DNA recognition by the Rad4/XPC damage sensor protein.
authors: Tavakoli, Amirrasoul; Paul, Debamita; Mu, Hong; Kuchlyan, Jagannath; Baral, Saroj; Ansari, Anjum; Broyde, Suse; Min, Jung-Hyun
one_liner_zh: 该文利用光可裂解DNA调控Rad4/XPC损伤传感器的DNA识别，结合分子动力学模拟研究损伤DNA构象变化，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且含物理模拟，但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移。
abstract: Biomolecular structural changes upon binding/unbinding are key to their functions. However, characterization of such dynamical processes is difficult as it requires ways to rapidly and specifically trigger the assembly/disassembly as well as ways to monitor the resulting changes over time. Recently, various chemical strategies have been developed to use light to trigger changes in oligonucleotide structures, and thereby their activities. Here we report that photocleavable DNA can be used to modulate the DNA binding of the Rad4/XPC DNA repair complex using light. Rad4/XPC specifically recognizes diverse helix-destabilizing/distorting lesions including bulky organic adduct lesions and functions as a key initiator for the eukaryotic nucleotide excision repair (NER) pathway. We show that the 6-nitropiperonyloxymethyl (NPOM)-modified DNA is recognized by the Rad4 protein as a specific substrate and that the specific binding can be abolished by light-induced cleavage of the NPOM group from DNA in a dose-dependent manner. Fluorescence lifetime-based analyses of the DNA conformations suggest that free NPOM-DNA retains B-DNA-like conformations despite its bulky NPOM adduct, but Rad4-binding causes it to be heterogeneously distorted. Subsequent extensive conformational searches and molecular dynamics simulations demonstrate that NPOM in DNA can be housed in the major groove of the DNA, with stacking interactions among the nucleotide pairs remaining largely unperturbed and thus retaining overall B-DNA conformation. Our work suggests that photoactivable DNA may be used as a DNA lesion surrogate to study DNA repair mechanisms such as nucleotide excision repair.
abstract_zh: 生物分子在结合/解离过程中的结构变化对其功能至关重要。然而，表征此类动态过程颇具挑战，因为这需要能够快速且特异性地触发组装/解组装的方法，以及随时间监测所引起变化的手段。近年来，已开发出多种化学策略，利用光触发寡核苷酸结构的变化，进而调控其活性。在此，我们报道了光可裂解DNA可用于通过光调节Rad4/XPC DNA修复复合物的DNA结合能力。Rad4/XPC特异性地识别多种螺旋去稳定/扭曲损伤，包括大体积有机加合物损伤，并作为真核核苷酸切除修复（NER）途径的关键启动因子发挥作用。我们展示了6-硝基哌啶氧甲基（NPOM）修饰的DNA被Rad4蛋白识别为特异性底物，且这种特异性结合可通过光诱导从DNA上裂解NPOM基团而被剂量依赖性地消除。基于荧光寿命的DNA构象分析表明，尽管存在大体积NPOM加合物，游离的NPOM-DNA仍保持类似B-DNA的构象，但Rad4结合后导致其发生异质性扭曲。随后的广泛构象搜索和分子动力学模拟表明，DNA中的NPOM可容纳于DNA大沟内，核苷酸对间的堆叠相互作用基本未受干扰，从而维持整体B-DNA构象。我们的工作表明，光活化DNA可能作为DNA损伤替代物，用于研究核苷酸切除修复等DNA修复机制。
